cds.title: Loyola University New Orleans Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds.title: College Navigator - Loyola University New Orleans (IPEDS, fall 2024 admissions)

stats.notes: Common Data Set, fall 2025 entering class: 6,080 applicants, 5,507 admitted (90.6%), 752 enrolled. The Common Data Set's men and women rows sum to 6,066 applicants and 5,495 admits; the form's total cells read 6,080 and 5,507, which are the figures shown. The Common Data Set does not report an in-state, out-of-state or international breakdown of applicants (the residency table is blank), so no international admit rate is shown. College Navigator shows 5,140 applicants / 93% admitted for fall 2024. Test scores: 46 enrollees (6%) submitted SAT and 298 (40%) ACT; SAT composite 25th/50th/75th = 1092.5/1165/1285. GPA: 99.47% reported a high school GPA (average 3.54); the GPA breakdown percentages are shares of all first-years, so they sum to 99.47. Undergraduate enrollment is 2,871 and nonresident students number 135 (the 'Total Undergraduates' figures; College Navigator fall 2024: 3,007). Student-faculty ratio 12:1 (2,967 students / 252 faculty).

cds_test_policy.notes: Test policy, from the Common Data Set: 'Test Optional; Placement is determined by voluntarily submitted official SAT/ACT scores: AP, IB, and CLEP exams; or dual-enrollment or transfer'.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2026-27, first-year, residential): tuition $51,008; required fees $2,400; housing $9,680 + meals $6,500 = $16,180; books $1,394; transportation $1,072 + other $2,862 = $3,934. The total cost of attendance is the sum of those components (not a printed total). The college's own need-based and non-need-based aid are both marked available to nonresidents; 109 nonresidents received it, average $32,309, total $3,521,657 (the Common Data Set also counts 109 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates)
